title: PromptFormatConfig
description: Contract 8: Configuration for formatting SubgraphContext for LLM consumption.

format.description: Target format: markdown, structured, or none.

max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget for the formatted text.

include_citations.description: Whether to include inline citations and provenance footers.

include_metrics.description: Whether to append execution metrics to the output.

include_provenance.description: Whether to include source documents and traversal trajectories.
